research_object: Task-specific, evidence-calibrated resolution claims in optical microscopy.
constraints: Keep conventional diffraction limits distinct from the added information channel used by a super-resolution method.
Separate localization precision, structural resolution, coordinate accuracy, and temporal resolution.
Bind every proposed claim to calibration, sampling, labeling, drift, and reconstruction evidence.
Do not claim that a proposed benchmark has been acquired or that any method has won the benchmark.

recommended_seed.title: TraceRes: a task-specific resolution passport for credible optical nanoscopy
recommended_seed.mechanism: Represent each imaging claim by a typed resolution objective, a declared information channel, a multi-term error budget, blinded calibration cases, and a bounded release status.
